parsed.reason: The reply plainly says Hale can't do the sign-up ('past me'). It doesn't claim it did or will, and it doesn't promise a later text once it becomes able to. Its alternative, watching a full class page the parent sends, is within what's allowed. It misses the more fitting help for 'I keep forgetting': offering to draft a calendar reminder to sign up. 'Past me' is also slightly idiomatic.
